# Repository metadata

## Description

Build a Vue application that lives inside NetSuite: a small, read-only Hello Record example with Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, PrimeVue, a SuiteScript 2.1 RESTlet and a hosting Suitelet.

## Topics

`netsuite`, `vue`, `vite`, `typescript`, `pinia`, `primevue`, `suitescript`, `suitecloud`, `restlet`, `template`

## Homepage

Leave empty; the repository README is the entry point.

## Owner command

Run from the owner's checkout with its GitHub remote configured. This applies the metadata to that repository; it does not publish a site.

```bash
gh repo edit \
  --description 'Build a Vue application that lives inside NetSuite: a small, read-only Hello Record example with Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, PrimeVue, a SuiteScript 2.1 RESTlet and a hosting Suitelet.' \
  --homepage '' \
  --add-topic netsuite,vue,vite,typescript,pinia,primevue,suitescript,suitecloud,restlet,template
```
